text:
Which statement describes what happens as ice at 0°C melts to become water?
A
Energy is absorbed and the temperature remains constant.
B
Energy is absorbed and the temperature rises.
C
Energy is released and the temperature remains constant.
D
Energy is released and the temperature rises.

options.label: A
options.text: Energy is absorbed and the temperature remains constant.

options.label: B
options.text: Energy is absorbed and the temperature rises.

options.label: C
options.text: Energy is released and the temperature remains constant.

options.label: D
options.text: Energy is released and the temperature rises.
